description: Mã sự kiện tuân thủ (nhánh kiểm tra) — PK duy nhất (Bảng Tác nghiệp), thống nhất tên cột PK cho cả 3 nhánh UNION (Admin Penalty/Inspection/Examination). Driving Table: Penalty Decision Subject (penalty_decision_subject) — nguồn track draft DataModel/working/Atomic/lld/THANHTRA/lld_THANHTRA_PENALTY_DECISION_SUBJECT.yaml, chưa approved.

Mã CTCK bị kiểm tra — GAP: chưa có FK surrogate chính thức từ Penalty Decision Subject/Examination Team Target tới Securities Company, chỉ text-match qua Target Reference Id. Cần xác nhận chất lượng dữ liệu (Target Reference Id có luôn khớp Securities Company.sc_code không) trước khi đưa vào production.
etl_logic: JOIN examination_team_target ON examination_team_target.target_nm = penalty_decision_subject.subject_nm AND examination_team_target.src_stm_code = 'THANHTRA_EXAMINATION_TEAM_TARGET' -> examination_team_target.target_reference_id WHERE examination_team_target.target_tp_code = 'SECURITIES_COMPANY' -> JOIN securities_company ON securities_company.sc_code = examination_team_target.target_reference_id (text-match cross-system — chưa có FK surrogate chính thức)
source_attribute: Target Reference Id / Securities Company Code

description: Loại sự kiện tuân thủ — ETL hardcode 'EXAMINATION' cho bộ này.

Loại kiểm tra: PERIODIC=Kiểm tra định kỳ; UNSCHEDULED=Kiểm tra đột xuất. JOIN Examination Team qua Examination Team Target (text match Target Name = Subject Name — xem O_QLKD_13, chưa có FK surrogate chính thức).
etl_logic: JOIN examination_team_target ON examination_team_target.target_nm = penalty_decision_subject.subject_nm AND examination_team_target.src_stm_code = 'THANHTRA_EXAMINATION_TEAM_TARGET' -> JOIN examination_team ON examination_team.examination_team_id = examination_team_target.examination_team_id AND examination_team.src_stm_code = 'THANHTRA_EXAMINATION_TEAM' -> examination_team.form_tp_code

description: Ngày ban hành quyết định kiểm tra.
etl_logic: JOIN examination_team_target ON examination_team_target.target_nm = penalty_decision_subject.subject_nm AND examination_team_target.src_stm_code = 'THANHTRA_EXAMINATION_TEAM_TARGET' -> JOIN examination_team ON examination_team.examination_team_id = examination_team_target.examination_team_id AND examination_team.src_stm_code = 'THANHTRA_EXAMINATION_TEAM' -> examination_team.decision_dt
JOIN penalty_decision ON penalty_decision.pd_id = penalty_decision_subject.pd_id AND penalty_decision.src_stm_code = 'THANHTRA_PENALTY_DECISION' -> penalty_decision.decision_nbr

description: Ngày ban hành quyết định xử phạt.
etl_logic: JOIN penalty_decision ON penalty_decision.pd_id = penalty_decision_subject.pd_id AND penalty_decision.src_stm_code = 'THANHTRA_PENALTY_DECISION' -> penalty_decision.issued_dt

description: Hành vi vi phạm. JOIN Penalty Decision Subject Behavior -> Violation Behavior.
etl_logic: JOIN pd_subject_behavior ON pd_subject_behavior.pd_subject_id = penalty_decision_subject.pd_subject_id AND pd_subject_behavior.src_stm_code = 'THANHTRA_PENALTY_DECISION_SUBJECT_BEHAVIOR' -> JOIN violation_behavior ON violation_behavior.violation_behavior_id = pd_subject_behavior.violation_behavior_id AND violation_behavior.src_stm_code = 'THANHTRA_VIOLATION_BEHAVIOR' -> violation_behavior.violation_behavior_nm
source_entity: Penalty Decision Subject Behavior / Violation Behavior

description: Hình thức xử phạt bổ sung (nếu có) — Penalty Type WHERE penalty_category_code = 'SUPPLEMENTARY_PENALTY', else NULL.
etl_logic: JOIN pd_subject_behavior ON pd_subject_behavior.pd_subject_id = penalty_decision_subject.pd_subject_id AND pd_subject_behavior.src_stm_code = 'THANHTRA_PENALTY_DECISION_SUBJECT_BEHAVIOR' -> JOIN penalty_type ON penalty_type.penalty_tp_id = pd_subject_behavior.penalty_tp_id AND penalty_type.src_stm_code = 'THANHTRA_PENALTY_TYPE' AND penalty_type.penalty_category_code = 'SUPPLEMENTARY_PENALTY' -> penalty_type.penalty_tp_nm
source_entity: Penalty Decision Subject Behavior / Penalty Type

description: Biện pháp khắc phục (nếu có) — Penalty Type WHERE penalty_category_code = 'REMEDIAL_MEASURE', else NULL.
etl_logic: JOIN pd_subject_behavior ON pd_subject_behavior.pd_subject_id = penalty_decision_subject.pd_subject_id AND pd_subject_behavior.src_stm_code = 'THANHTRA_PENALTY_DECISION_SUBJECT_BEHAVIOR' -> JOIN penalty_type ON penalty_type.penalty_tp_id = pd_subject_behavior.penalty_tp_id AND penalty_type.src_stm_code = 'THANHTRA_PENALTY_TYPE' AND penalty_type.penalty_category_code = 'REMEDIAL_MEASURE' -> penalty_type.penalty_tp_nm
source_entity: Penalty Decision Subject Behavior / Penalty Type

description: Mã hệ thống nguồn dữ liệu.
